[[File:2418.png|right]] 24.18 ==The Ashberry Mountains== Region: [[The Barrier Range]]

Connects to: 05.04, 20.00, 23.11, 25.17, 26.13, 26.20, 29.13, 29.14.32, 29.14.35 and the '''Freeholds'''.

[[The Osseries]], who shoot jets of flame from their fingertips at will, dwell in this stretch of the '''Barrier Peaks'''. '''Ashberry bushes '''are cultivated here by flame from the Osserys; the Osserys use the ashberries to make '''Ossery Fire'''.

====Hooks==== *

Have any of the controlled fires gotten out of hand?
